WARDEN FIELD GUIDE

Take cover during the targeting beam. WARDEN locks its aim before firing, giving you time to sprint aside.

The blue underside core takes increased damage while cooling. During repairs it turns amber: three accurate hits interrupt the repair and expose the core for longer.

Gold ground rings mark incoming strikes. In overload, strikes alternate with a slow sweep across a gold lane. The marked path stays fixed: step off it or shelter behind solid cover before the sweep arrives. Shields recover after five seconds without damage.

The cameras remain disabled. Severing the command core in Lower Station destroyed all surviving surface patrols, including smaller drones. WARDEN runs on independent power and launches two onboard reserve drones during its repair phase. You have returned from the lower station. The service lift stays open, but its controls are offline. Neutralize WARDEN to complete the operation.
